result.title: Provably Efficient Offline Discounted Reinforcement Learning under Recursive Entropic Risk
result.summary: We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with recursive entropic risk measures (ERM), parameterized by $β\neq 0$. We consider both risk-averse ($β>0$) and risk-seeking ($β<0$) settings. We consider the offline RL setting, where the agent is provided with a fixed dataset and wishes to learn a near-optimal policy using this dataset. We introduce a model-based algorithm, called ERM Value Iteration Lower Confidence Bound (ERM-VI-LCB) and derive a PAC-type bound on its sample complexity. We also establish a corresponding lower bound, demonstrating that exponential dependence on $|β|/(1-γ)$ asserted by the upper bound is unavoidable in the worst case. The presented bounds provide the first rigorous sample complexity guarantees for offline RL under recursive ERM across both risk-averse and risk-seeking regimes.

AI.brief_summary: 研究有限折扣 MDP 下递归熵风险测度（ERM）的离线风险敏感 RL，涵盖风险厌恶与风险偏好两种情形，提出基于模型的 ERM-VI-LCB 算法，给出样本复杂度上界及匹配下界。
AI.relevance_reason: 递归风险备份算子与 LCB 悲观化可能为 LVR 中不确定性感知的停止决策、离线轨迹训练的保守估计提供形式化线索，可供核查；与视觉推理本身无直接联系。
